class: Submission evidence omitted because receipt markup is not semantic
symptom: The page displays Application Submitted in a visible span, but the manual watcher cannot verify it and the application tab remains open.
root_cause: The watcher only inspected headings, paragraphs and alert/status elements, excluding standalone div and span receipts recorded in the saved confirmation structure diagnostic.
why_tests_missed: Existing receipt tests used semantic headings, paragraphs or explicit status roles; none exercised generic elements through the wait and browser teardown.
fix: Inspect visible div and span text with the existing complete-phrase matcher and unfinished-form checks. Reject inline fragments surrounded by other sentence text. Let confirmed receipts finish the wait and normal teardown close the browser.
prevention: Exercise observed DOM shapes in browser regressions, covering both completion and contextual false positives rather than assuming semantic markup.
